sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year bachelor's before enrollment; mathematics/related discipline with one advanced year beyond
calculus/basic linear algebra. UChicago degree fits; record review still required. [s1]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Select Mathematics: Doctoral/Atlanta/Fall 2027; prepare academic credentials, CV/SOP, three referees; resolve
English and fee waiver. [s2] [s3] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Admissions: dgs@math.gatech.edu; no prior supervisor agreement stated. [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Doctoral listing independently verified; supplemental sections vary; submitted application cannot be modified.
[s2] [s3]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit Fall 2027 deadline; stipend quote is Fall 2025. [s1] [s2] [s6]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
All applicants demonstrate English at application beginning Fall 2027. Math: old TOEFL 96/each19; new TOEFL
overall4.5, R/L/W4, speaking3.5; IELTS7, R/L/S6.5, W5.5. MyBest not accepted. [s2] [s4]

UChicago English exemption [2027 confirmed]
Completed UChicago degree qualifies. If not yet conferred, policy wording is 'earned' and 'at application';
obtain confirmation before assuming prospective conferral suffices. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Optional for Fall 2027; submitted scores considered. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Fall 2025 estimate approximately USD37,500 per 12 months, plus tuition waiver; not a confirmed 2027 figure.
Fees/insurance unresolved. [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Unresolved]
School says all PhD students funded; exact multi-year guarantee/renewal conditions unresolved. [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
All PhD students advertised as funded without nationality limit; individual appointment requirements govern.
[s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA/RA or equivalent support with tuition waiver; duties/progress conditions require offer verification. [s7]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate School of Math funding application. [s7]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Institute/internal fellowships and Stamps listed; exact international eligibility/amount requires award
verification. [s1] [s2]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD105 international, nonrefundable/nontransferable, each application. [s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Institute program-participant waivers require documents. Central office excludes international financial
hardship. Complete materials/English first; after Institute denial ask Math about departmental waiver. [s8] [s9]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Harold Blum
Birational geometry, K-stability, Fano/Calabi-Yau varieties and moduli. [s10] [s11] [s14]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2020;2026 award; newer papers pending · Reductivity of the automorphism group of K-polystable Fano
varieties
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Josephine Yu
Tropical and real algebraic geometry, polyhedral and algebraic combinatorics; tropicalizations of determinantal
loci and principal minors, positivity and Ehrhart theory. [s10] [s15] [qbr6_q6] [qbr6_q7] [qbr6_q8] [qbr6_q9]

Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2025 · Tropicalizing Principal Minors of Positive Definite Matrices
With Abeer Al Ahmadieh, Felipe Rincón and Cynthia Vinzant; original 2024, revised 29 August 2025. Tropical flag varieties,
submodularity and realizable matroids.
Research evidence: 2026 · Positivity and log concavity of the Links-Gould polynomial of knots
With Stavros Garoufalidis and Shana Yunsheng Li; submitted 29 May 2026. Official Georgia Tech author bibliography and indexed
arXiv record confirm paper; direct arXiv opening failed during audit.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Tropical geometry; current publication-page fetch failed.
Number theory
Matt Baker
Number theory, algebraic geometry, complex dynamics and combinatorics; particularly Berkovich spaces,
tropical geometry and matroids. Current papers connect modular curves and matroid realization spaces. [s10]
[s12] [qbr5_q1] [qbr5_q2] [qbr5_q3] [qbr5_q4] [qbr5_q5]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · Elliptic matroids and modular curves
Submitted 5 August 2026. Models modular curves as matroid realization spaces using deformation theory.
Research evidence: 2026 · A modern perspective on Tutte's homotopy theorem
With Tong Jin and Oliver Lorscheid; revised 22 October 2026. Matroid foundations, universal cross-ratios and representation
theory of matroids.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Berkovich spaces, tropical geometry, matroids, arithmetic geometry/complex dynamics.
Alexander Dunn
Analytic number theory, automorphic forms and L-functions. [s10] [s14]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2024 · Bias in cubic Gauss sums: Patterson's conjecture
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Representation theory
Anton Zeitlin
Quantum groups, q-Langlands, integrable systems and enumerative geometry. [s10] [s13]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2024 · The Zoo of Opers and Dualities
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
